free_tier.stated: A free cloud lane onto SiMa.ai MLSoC and MLSoC Modalix silicon: 'Currently Edgematic is in beta and available for free on the Amazon Web Services (AWS) Marketplace. To obtain access, click link. To sign up, you will need an AWS account.' The architecture guide states the point: Edgematic 'provides a cloud-based, low-code environment where users can design, deploy, and benchmark pipelines', with 'No Hardware Requirements: Allows developers to test and optimize pipelines without purchasing a SiMa DevKit'.

retention.stated: the beta is the clock and it has no committed end date; each run allocates one device and the job is a GStreamer pipeline, not a general compute job.

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: Composes with an AWS account that exists for other reasons: the same account that runs a free-tier instance can subscribe at no stated cost. It breaks at the model boundary, because the pipeline must be a graph of compiled models, so arbitrary training is out of reach.
